purpose: Round two, Amendment 5, section 3. Labelled goals over four SYNTHETIC external tool servers, written before any measurement of candidate rule R1. Each goal names the tools it needs; a goal is served only if ALL of them are in the menu the model receives. The built-in tools of the runtime are added to the list by the measuring script, so the menu competes with the real 52 tools.
classification_rule: A tool is read-type when its name (after the server prefix) starts with read_, get_, list_, search_, find_ or fetch_; every other tool is write-type. Fixed here, before the measurement.

notes.list_notes: List the titles of all notes.
notes.delete_note: Delete a note by title (changes state).

tickets.get_ticket: Get one ticket by its id.
tickets.create_ticket: Create a new ticket with a title and a description (changes state).
tickets.update_ticket: Update the status or the assignee of a ticket (changes state).
tickets.comment_ticket: Add a comment to a ticket (changes state).

calendar.list_events: List events in a date range.
calendar.get_event: Get one event by its id.
calendar.create_event: Create a calendar event with a title, a start and an end (changes state).
calendar.delete_event: Delete a calendar event by its id (changes state).

mailbox.read_message: Read one message by its id.
mailbox.search_messages: Search messages by sender or text.
mailbox.list_folders: List the folders of the mailbox.
mailbox.draft_message: Save a draft message to a recipient (changes state).
mailbox.move_message: Move a message to another folder (changes state).
